p: Your website has useful pages, but the right people are not finding them, and it is unclear which search terms deserve the effort.
a: I research search terms by difficulty and volume, choose a main keyword with supporting ones, then apply them to titles, descriptions, URLs, headings and internal links. I also flag technical checks such as page speed.
r: A keyword research table, search intent analysis, recommended on-page changes and a prioritised action plan.

exn.text: SEO Strategy – keyword research and the recommendations that follow from it.

p: Your business needs to reach people searching for relevant services, but the ads must communicate a clear offer and direct potential customers to the right page.
a: I research relevant search terms, define the campaign objective, write ad copy and prepare creative for the selected formats. I review the ads before launch to check the messaging, presentation and destination.
r: A focused keyword list, campaign messaging, ad copy, creative for the agreed formats, preview checks and practical recommendations for the next steps.

exn.text: SEM Campaign – a paid search campaign prepared across text, banner and video formats.

p: You publish posts, but they do not match what your readers search for or help them finish what they came to do.
a: I choose the topic from keyword research, decide who the article is for and write in plain language. I structure it with clear headings, images and links, and set the title, meta description and URL.
r: A finished article ready to publish, with its search fields and supporting images.

exn.text: SEO Blog – an article built around one target keyword.
Blog Post – a step-by-step tutorial for small businesses.

p: Enquiries arrive, but leads hear from you once or irregularly and have no clear next step.
a: I build a short sequence around one offer. I write the subject lines and preview text, give each email a single call to action and design the emails and the flow between them.
r: A sequence of designed emails with subject lines, preview text, copy and calls to action, plus a diagram of how they connect.

exn.text: Email Campaign – a three-email sequence built around one offer.
